name: Seishin Hakai
source:
That bizarre incident occurred at 8 PM. Girl student was murdered with face distorted violently. Strange killings keep happening around the hero. When judgement and emotions disappear something is going to break...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
那个离奇事件发生在晚上8点。一名女学生遇害，脸部遭到严重扭曲。主人公身边不断发生诡异的杀人案。当判断与情感消失时，某种东西将会崩坏……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
